title: Degree-two vanishing for the infinitesimal units kernel
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves]. Let $i:C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ be the reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] and $\varphi:i^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,C}\to\mathbf G_{m,C_{\mathrm{red}}}$ the transpose of restriction of units [def-sc-gm-torsor] under the adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $K=\ker\varphi$ be its kernel in the category of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] (sections mapped to the identity). Then $H^2((C_{\mathrm{red}})_{\mathrm{Et}},K)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Empty, zero-dimensional and disconnected curves are allowed; no smoothness, properness or reducedness is assumed.

proof.text: Finite type over a field makes C Noetherian; its coherent nilradical N is nilpotent with a uniform exponent m obtained on a finite affine cover. Etale flatness identifies the pulled-back nilradical on an affine etale object with its reduction ideal, since the quotient is etale over a reduced scheme and is reduced. Thus the kernel K of G_m,C -> i_*G_m,C_red is the sheaf 1+N_et.

For j≥1 the formula 1+a ↦ a induces (1+N^j)/(1+N^(j+1)) ≅ (N^j/N^(j+1))_et. The cross term ab lies in N^(2j)⊆N^(j+1). Flat pullback to an affine etale object preserves the exact sequence of the ideals, so the formula is surjective there and has the indicated kernel; sheafification preserves these identities.

Every quasi-coherent etale sheaf has vanishing H^q for q≥2 on C. Choose a finite affine cover; separatedness makes its finite intersections affine. Affine etale vanishing and the Cech spectral sequence identify its etale cohomology with the Cech groups of this cover. Affine Zariski vanishing and the same spectral sequence identify those groups with Zariski cohomology. Noetherian cohomology vanishes above dimension, and dim C≤1.

Descend from N^m=0 using the filtration short exact sequences. At each j the long exact sequence is exact at H^2(1+N^j); both the H^2 of the next filtration piece and the H^2 of the additive quotient vanish. Therefore H^2(1+N_et)=0.

The reduction is a universal homeomorphism. Its inverse image is an exact equivalence and its counit is an isomorphism, so i^{-1}K identifies with ker(varphi). Topological invariance identifies H^2(C,K) with H^2(C_red,i^{-1}K), proving the stated vanishing.
